home.title: Sercomm Corporation
home.desc: Sercomm Corporation, headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, is a leading global supplier of telecom broadband solutions. Serving frontline telecom operations in Europe, America, Japan, and emerging markets, our cutting-edge products are backed by advanced manufacturing and R&D centers worldwide. Our portfolio includes Mobile Network, Broadband Solutions, IoT Solutions, and Enterprise Solutions.

subpages.title: Switch | Private Network | Enterprise Solutions | Solutions
subpages.desc: With over 25 years of expertise in Ethernet hardware & software design, Sercomm provides cost-effective, qualified switch solutions in a range of speeds, including 1G, 2.5G, 5G, 10G, 25G, 40G, and 100G, supporting both Layer 2 and Layer 3 functionalities. Sercomm also delivers access and aggregation PoE switch products and solutions tailored for the carrier, enterprise, and industrial markets.

subpages.title: Smart D4.0 Network Repeater | Broadband Solutions | Solutions
subpages.desc: Viper-SC Smart D4.0 Network Repeater offers 1.8GHz bandwidth high gain, higher output level with DPD to save power consumption in infrastructure. And has internal DSP/CPU to perform FDX echo cancellation, continuous-wave cancelers (CWCs) to eliminate the inter-carrier interferences from CTW sounding signal. Viper-SC Smart D4.0 Network Repeater has remote controllable N-split support for 85/108MHz

subpages.desc: The Sercomm TPM54x series is a high-performance, multi-band dual-mode LTE-M/NB-IoT module designed for ultra-low power consumption.
